# TrueConf
> Secure video conferencing and unified communications platform with on-premises and cloud collaboration products.

TrueConf provides enterprise video meetings, team messaging, webinars, room systems, and developer tools, with extensive documentation, downloads, and support resources for self-hosted and cloud deployments.

## Main Product Pages
- [TrueConf Server](https://trueconf.com/products/server/video-conferencing-server.html): On-premises video conferencing server for corporate communications and collaboration.
- [TrueConf Online](https://trueconf.com/products/online/video-conferencing-service.html): Cloud video conferencing service for meetings, calls, and team collaboration.
- [TrueConf MCU](https://trueconf.com/products/server/video-conferencing-server-for-linux.html): Multipoint conferencing solution for Linux-based deployments and enterprise infrastructure.
- [TrueConf Room](https://trueconf.com/products/room/video-conferencing-software-for-meeting-rooms.html): Software for meeting rooms with conference control and room collaboration features.
- [TrueConf Group](https://trueconf.com/products/group/video-conferencing-endpoint.html): Hardware video conferencing endpoint for переговорные and conference rooms.
- [TrueConf Kiosk](https://trueconf.com/products/kiosk/self-service-video-kiosk.html): Self-service video kiosk solution for remote customer service and communications.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://trueconf.com/docs/): Central documentation portal for TrueConf products, deployment, and administration.
- [TrueConf Server Documentation](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/): Admin and user documentation for deploying and managing TrueConf Server.
- [TrueConf MCU Documentation](https://trueconf.com/docs/mcu/en/): Documentation for installing and configuring TrueConf MCU deployments.
- [TrueConf Room Documentation](https://trueconf.com/docs/room/en/): Guides for configuring and operating TrueConf Room systems.
- [TrueConf Group Documentation](https://trueconf.com/docs/group/en/): Manuals and setup guidance for TrueConf Group hardware endpoints.
- [TrueConf Kiosk Documentation](https://trueconf.com/docs/kiosk/en/): Documentation for deploying and administering TrueConf Kiosk solutions.
- [TrueConf Online Documentation](https://trueconf.com/docs/online/en/): Help materials for using the TrueConf cloud service.

## User Applications
- [Windows App](https://trueconf.com/downloads/windows.html): Desktop client for video calls, conferences, messaging, and collaboration on Windows.
- [macOS App](https://trueconf.com/downloads/macos.html): Native macOS client for meetings, calls, and team communications.
- [Linux App](https://trueconf.com/downloads/linux.html): Linux desktop application for secure conferencing and messaging.
- [Android App](https://trueconf.com/downloads/android.html): Mobile app for Android devices with calling and conferencing features.
- [iOS App](https://trueconf.com/downloads/ios.html): iPhone and iPad app for secure video meetings and communications.
- [TrueConf Room Downloads](https://trueconf.com/downloads/trueconf-room.html): Installation packages for meeting room software deployments.
- [All Downloads](https://trueconf.com/downloads/): Download center for clients, server software, and related tools.

## Server Administration and Deployment
- [Server Installation](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/installing-trueconf-server.html): Steps for installing TrueConf Server in enterprise environments.
- [Server Configuration](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/configuring-trueconf-server.html): Core configuration tasks for networking, services, and system settings.
- [User Management](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/managing-user-accounts.html): Managing user accounts, permissions, and directory integration.
- [Federation](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/federation.html): Configure federation between TrueConf servers for intercompany communications.
- [SIP/H.323 Integration](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/sip-h323.html): Integrate telephony and legacy conferencing systems with TrueConf Server.
- [Monitoring and Statistics](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/monitoring-and-statistics.html): Monitor system health, usage, and conference statistics.
- [Backup and Restore](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/backup-and-restore.html): Protect server configuration and data with backup procedures.

## End-User Guides
- [Client User Guide](https://trueconf.com/docs/client/en/): End-user documentation for TrueConf desktop and mobile applications.
- [Making Calls](https://trueconf.com/docs/client/en/user/making-calls.html): Instructions for placing point-to-point video and audio calls.
- [Joining Conferences](https://trueconf.com/docs/client/en/user/joining-conferences.html): How users join scheduled and ad hoc conferences.
- [Messaging and Presence](https://trueconf.com/docs/client/en/user/chats-and-presence.html): Use chats, status indicators, and team communication features.
- [Screen Sharing](https://trueconf.com/docs/client/en/user/screen-sharing.html): Share screens and content during meetings and calls.
- [Address Book](https://trueconf.com/docs/client/en/user/address-book.html): Manage contacts, groups, and directory entries.
- [Conference Management](https://trueconf.com/docs/client/en/user/conference-management.html): Control participant roles and meeting options during conferences.

- [REST API](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/rest-api.html): Reference information for automating server management tasks.
- [Webhook Integration](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/webhooks.html): Configure webhooks for event-driven integrations and notifications.
- [SIP Trunk Integration](https://trueconf.com/docs/server/en/admin/sip-trunk.html): Connect SIP trunks and telephony services to TrueConf infrastructure.
- [Third-Party Integrations](https://trueconf.com/integrations/): Overview of supported integrations and interoperability options.
